idleLines: The line is still there, under the grass. It outlasts everything built on it.

mission.done: The painted runway appears for a few steps, then fades. A park that remembers it was an airfield.

introLines.text: I walk the runway line every morning. The park grew over it, but the line is still there.
Walk it end to end with me, then stand on the ghost line.

idleLines: Every year grows something; no year grows nothing.

introLines.text: Pick a packet — each one is labelled with a year.
Plant it, imagined, and walk back to the park to see what grew.

future2029: 2029 — a question, in words only. The park is still a park. The line is still under the grass. What would you want this ground to remember?
name: Tachikawa — Airfield to Park

side.intro: When it rains, the painted path shines like a runway. Make it rain, then land 3 paper planes.
side.result: All three planes land. The planes always land.
side.title: The Rain Runway

subtitle: A park that remembers it was an airfield: the runway line under the grass, the base town, the park gate. Painted, present day.
